block_row: [EXISTS, Long] Two 6144 x 256 synchronous BRAM banks that swap roles. A small role FSM keeps which bank is being written and which is being read, toggles the write bank on write-done and the read bank on read-done, and keeps a full flag per bank. Writes are steered to the write bank; reads go to the read bank and the output is selected with the read-bank select delayed by one cycle because the BRAM has one cycle of read latency.

frame_row: [EXISTS, Long] Two 6144 x 256 synchronous BRAM banks that swap roles. A small role FSM keeps which bank is being written and which is being read, toggles the write bank on write-done and the read bank on read-done, and keeps a full flag per bank. Writes are steered to the write bank; reads go to the read bank and the output is selected with the read-bank select delayed by one cycle because the BRAM has one cycle of read latency.

label: Bank role FSM
(FG of bram_pp)
blocks.function: Holds the write-bank and read-bank selects and the two full flags. Sets a full flag and toggles the write bank when the last word of a bank is written; clears it and toggles the read bank when the reader reports done. Reports a free bank to the DMA and the full flags to the reader. Synchronous reset (open: consistency with other blocks).

label: Write steering
(FG of bram_pp)
blocks.function: Routes the single write port (enable, address, data) to the bank selected by the role FSM; the other bank sees no write.

label: u_bank0
(bram_6144x256)
blocks.function: Bank 0: 6144 words of 256 bit (196 608 B, one 768 x 256 INT8 chunk), one write port and one synchronous read port.

label: Read port
(FG of bram_pp)
blocks.function: Sends the read address to the read bank and selects the output word with the read-bank select delayed one cycle to match the synchronous BRAM latency.

label: u_bank1
(bram_6144x256)
blocks.function: Bank 1: identical to bank 0; written while bank 0 is read, and the reverse after a swap.

interfaces.name: Bank 0 read port
interfaces.signals: re0, raddr[12:0]; u_bank0 -> Read port: dout0[255:0]

interfaces.name: Bank 1 read port
interfaces.signals: re1, raddr[12:0]; u_bank1 -> Read port: dout1[255:0]

interfaces.name: BRAM read port (data part)
interfaces.signals: re, raddr[12:0]; Read port -> u_gemm: dout[255:0]

interfaces.name: Bank status (status part of BWR and BRD)
interfaces.signals: Bank role FSM -> u_dma: wr_ready [level], wr_done [pulse]; u_gemm -> Bank role FSM: rd_done [pulse]; Bank role FSM -> u_gemm: full[1:0] [level]

interfaces.name: Clock and reset
interfaces.signals: clk, rst (synchronous reset). u_bank0 uses the same clk; its branch is not drawn because all four sides of u_bank0 are taken by other connectors

legend_note: Architecture mode: drawn from project documents, not from RTL. [EXISTS] = block already written; [FIXED] = decided by Long; [PROPOSED] = Claude proposal; dashed outline = location or existence not decided. FG = functional group of the module own logic. [pulse] = one-cycle signal, [level] = held value.
